invariants.text: A customer can have multiple orders, but each order must be linked to exactly one customer.
A customer's email must be unique across all customers.
An order cannot be created with a customer_id that does not exist in the Customer table.
An order must be associated with a valid customer through the customer_id field.
An order must have at least one item in the order_items list to be valid.
Customer.email must be a string
Customer.email must not be null
Customer.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Customer.name must be a string
Customer.name must not be null
If an order is marked as cancelled, no further status changes can be applied to it.
If an order status is changed to 'completed', all order items must be marked as fulfilled.
Order.customer_id must be an integer
Order.customer_id must not be null
Order.customer_id must reference an existing Customer.id
Order.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Order.order_items must be a string
Order.order_items must not be null
Order.status must be a string
Order.status must not be null
The order_items list in an order must not contain duplicate items with the same product and quantity.
The status of an order must be one of 'pending', 'completed', or 'cancelled'.
The total order value is the sum of the prices of all items in the order_items list.
